outcome: Cell morphology changes (cell membrane and nuclear envelope boundary alterations, loss of cell volume, presence of stress bodies)
cohort: Primary human skeletal muscle cells isolated from rectus abdominis muscle samples obtained from healthy women undergoing programmed cesarean surgery.
finding: Exposure to DEHP inhibits human skeletal muscle cell proliferation and induces cell deterioration, evidenced by reduced cell abundance, altered morphology, and a significant reduction in satellite cell frequency and growth rate in primary culture conditions.
